name: University of St. Gallen
summary: Business, economics and law university in St. Gallen; the first year can be taken in English, leading to three majors studied mainly in English.

handoff.label: Assessment Year: German and English tracks

ib.text: 32/42; six subjects in HSG's groups, three at HL including maths or a science. Psychology, ESS, Visual Arts and others don't count. Non-Swiss applicants must pass HSG's online test and video interview.

dates.label: Bachelor's application opens (HSG's standing 1 Oct – 30 Apr period)
Complete application due to sit the February selection test
Register for the February selection test
Application closes; IB subjects and predicted grades due (standing date)

programmes.name: Major in Business Administration (BWL)
programmes.ib: Reached through the English-track Assessment Year; at least 12 ECTS of the major must be taken in German.

programmes.name: Major in Economics (VWL)
programmes.ib: Reached through the English-track Assessment Year, Economics specialisation.

programmes.name: Major in International Affairs (BIA)
programmes.ib: Reached through the English-track Assessment Year; at least 9 ECTS in German, and English at C2 plus a second foreign language by graduation.

notes: Places for non-Swiss applicants are limited by law, so only your online test and video interview decide, taken in the language of your chosen track.
In the English track the Assessment Year specialises in Economics or International Affairs; the Law and Law and Economics majors are taught in German.
You can take the selection procedure only once per academic year, and not in the year before your programme starts.
